Content txt file
>
name: cornucopias
services:
    pool-server:
        image: public.ecr.aws/cornucopias/nodes/pool-server:latest
        ports:
          - "8001:8001"
        restart: unless-stopped # if you want to manually start the pool server replace “unless-stopped” with “no”
        environment:
            FILENODES_POOL_ACCESS_KEY: <INSERT HERE>
            FILENODES_POOL_PUBLIC_PORT: 8001
        volumes:
          - ~/Cache:/cache

Ctrl-O -> Enter to run and save
Ctrl-X -> to exit

Run docker compose
> docker compose up -d

verify functionality
xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx:8001/health

check docker syncing progress and activity:
